# StickySites

> Sticky notes for every website: a Manifest V3 Chrome extension in vanilla JavaScript with six note types, a floating icon cluster, a rich-text workspace panel, a to-do list that can sync with a local TODO.md over native messaging, a global outliner library, and opt-in AES-256-GCM encryption. No build step, no network calls.

Version 1.11.1 · tests: `npm run lint && npm test` (101 vitest tests) · load unpacked from the repo root.


## Docs

- [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): StickySites is a Chrome Extension (Manifest V3) that injects a floating note workspace into every web page.

- [docs/MCP.md](docs/MCP.md): The hub server is the developer's machine-wide tool, not part of the extension.

## Source

- [manifest.json](manifest.json): MV3 manifest: 5 permissions, Alt+S command, 10 content scripts in load order, module service worker
- [package.json](package.json): Dev tooling (vitest, canvas) and npm scripts: test, lint, docs:check-indexes, logs:rotate, icons, verify:live
- [src/background/service-worker.js](src/background/service-worker.js): Context menus, Alt+S, popout window, native-messaging to-do sync scheduler
- [src/content/crypto-content.js](src/content/crypto-content.js): StickySites.Crypto: PBKDF2 + AES-256-GCM, cached key in chrome.storage.local
- [src/content/note-types.js](src/content/note-types.js): Six note-type descriptors with storage keys and identity icons
- [src/content/prefs.js](src/content/prefs.js): stickysites_prefs_v1 read/write
- [src/content/cluster.js](src/content/cluster.js): Floating icon cluster: drag, reorder, layout
- [src/content/todo.js](src/content/todo.js): To-do item normalisation and drag controller
- [src/content/outline-ops.js](src/content/outline-ops.js): Pure outline tree operations (unit-tested)
- [src/content/outline.js](src/content/outline.js): Outliner UI over a global library of named docs
- [src/content/mentions.js](src/content/mentions.js): @-mention autocomplete
- [src/content/panel.js](src/content/panel.js): Workspace panel: rich text, find & replace, to-do UI, auto-save, cross-tab sync, popout
- [src/content/sticky-inject.js](src/content/sticky-inject.js): Orchestrator: lock overlay, clip, Ctrl/Cmd+F1-F6, SPA watcher, message routing
- [src/shared/todo-bridge.js](src/shared/todo-bridge.js): Native-messaging to-do sync: request, merge, syncTodosWithHost
- [src/shared/crypto.js](src/shared/crypto.js): ES twin of the crypto primitives
- [src/shared/notes-storage.js](src/shared/notes-storage.js): Reference plaintext CRUD for all note types and prefs (tests)
- [popup.js](popup.js): Popup: lock screen, settings, search/sort/filter, export, Quick-Open
- [popout.js](popout.js): Popout: opens the Panel full-window for one note
- [tests/notes-storage.test.js](tests/notes-storage.test.js): 50 storage tests
- [tests/todo-bridge.test.js](tests/todo-bridge.test.js): 23 sync-merge tests
- [tests/outline-ops.test.js](tests/outline-ops.test.js): 21 outline tests
- [tests/crypto.test.js](tests/crypto.test.js): crypto primitive tests
- [scripts/check-syntax.mjs](scripts/check-syntax.mjs): npm run lint
- [scripts/check-doc-indexes.mjs](scripts/check-doc-indexes.mjs): npm run docs:check-indexes
- [scripts/rotate-workflow-logs.mjs](scripts/rotate-workflow-logs.mjs): npm run logs:rotate
- [scripts/verify-live.mjs](scripts/verify-live.mjs): npm run verify:live (puppeteer harness)
- [docs/high_signal_file_index.json](docs/high_signal_file_index.json): Machine-readable per-file index
- [.github/workflows/ci.yml](.github/workflows/ci.yml): CI: lint, test, index check, manifest validation
